name: eClerx Services Ltd
about: EClerx Services Ltd incorporated in 2000, provides business process management, automation and analytics services to a number of Fortune 2000 enterprises, including some of the world's leading financial services, communications, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure and technology companies[1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments

cons: Stock is trading at 8.06 times its book value
